pr.title: Fix search treating % and _ as wildcards

lenses.note: Bug fix with a failing test as spec; the change does what the PR says and nothing more.
No spec file in the change.
The new tests cover %, _ and \ against titles with and without them, and would fail without the escape. I did not run them because the Workers test runtime may be unavailable here. CI runs them.
The diff touches no docs, and I found no docs that describe search wildcard behaviour.
The escape regex escapes backslash first, in a single pass, and ESCAPE '\\' in JS is the SQL string '\'. The value is still bound as a parameter.
The query stays parameterised, so there is no injection. The change closes a wildcard-matching quirk.
The diff touches no UI files.
The diff touches no UI files.
The title is under 72 characters, and the body's claims match the diff.
